title: Unit Event — Parallel Harmonies — Episode5 Disconnected Harmonies

meta.Event Outline: Leo/need is finally going to start writing its debut song! However, Mr. Shindo has a request: that Saki and Ichika compose it together. The pair are determined to make it a great song, but things don't go so smoothly...

rows.Line: One hour later

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Alright, it's done...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Hehe. Hona's curry really did the trick!
I was able to breeze through that because of the boost of energy it gave me!

rows.Speaker: Ichika's Voice
rows.Line:
Saki, I'm finished with my melody.
How are things coming on your end?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, Ichi!
I just finished too!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Come on in so we can listen to them♪

rows.Speaker: Ichika's Voice
rows.Line:
Okay, sounds good.
In that case...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe. I can't wait to hear what we each came up with!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I'm a little nervous since I kind of did whatever I wanted with it...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Don't worry!
I really love the melodies you come up with!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: It's nice to actually hear someone say that.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Hehe♪ Alright, I'll go first!
You sit back and relax for now, Ichi!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm looking forward to hearing what you came up with, Saki.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (I wonder how Ichi's gonna react.)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (Hehe. I feel really good about this melody since I thought I came up with the perfect thing to go with her chord progression!)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (It's a little different from what Leo/need has done before, and I was able to work in my message.)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (Plus, I made sure to really respect the feelings Ichi put into this song.)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (So, I'm sure she'll love...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Um, Ichi...? How was it?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Oh, um...
It's pretty. I really like it.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Um, Saki...?
Can I ask why you decided to go with this melody?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Why? So, uh... Remember how you said you wanted your song to remind people about who matters most to them and stuff?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: So, I wanted people to remember the good times and bad times. The first time you met someone you really care about, or that one time you had a little fight...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I wanted it to be that kind of melody!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
I see...
Which explains why it felt a bit sad.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wait, was this not what you were looking for...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
No, it wasn't...
It's not quite what I had in mind...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I was looking for something a little more positive since it's supposed to be a straightforward expression of my feelings...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Straightforward...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Okay, got it...!
Now that I know this wasn't quite what you were looking for, I'll try giving it a quick fix!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Sorry, Saki...
I should've explained what I meant a little better.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
No, that's totally fine.
If anything, it's my fault for misunderstanding how you felt!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Anyway, uh... Can you show me what you made, Ichi?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Okay, I'll play it now.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Cool!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
(Swing and a miss...
But I had such a good feeling about it...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (I guess I sorta let my own feelings take over. I need to be more careful about that.)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (But as long as the melody Ichi came up with ends up being good, we can start polishing it...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (Wait, something's a bit off...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (I'm not sure how to put it into words...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Saki? Uhh...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Huh...?! S-Sorry.
I had to think about it for a second.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Was this also not what you were looking for...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I tried my best to capture what you said earlier about moving forward despite any doubts you may have.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah, it's just...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: It's too pop compared to what I imagined.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Too pop...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
No, that's not a bad thing!
I like how you want the listener to feel a sense of optimism!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But this song isn't supposed to be all sunshine and puppy dogs. I wanted it to be about feeling real empathy for someone.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Empathy, huh...?
Okay, got it...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Sorry I misunderstood what you were going for, Saki.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
No, that's okay.
Let's make our fixes and meet back up for another listen!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Okay! I'll be down in the living room.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Alright, see you in a bit!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: *Sigh*

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
This is so hard...
I was so sure I got it right...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
But I need to come up with a better melody...!
Because this song means a lot to us... To Leo/need...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: So, I gotta take what Ichi wanted and...
Several dozen minutes later

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: No, this still doesn't feel quite right...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: The melody sounds a lot more cheerful now, and I like how the tempo really picks up during the bridge, but...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Okay...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: So, can you tell me what specifically doesn't feel right?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Umm...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I guess how it still feels kind of sad. I can't seem to get that out of my head...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Wait, really?
I thought I really tried to shy away from that...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
I know...
But the first verse and chorus still feel that way to me.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
I'm really sorry, Ichi...
But can you try going more minor with it?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I like how quick the tempo is, but this song's not supposed to be all that cheerful...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But won't that take away from your theme of trying to move forward?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: N-No, I don't think so!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Also, a happy sound doesn't really go with my chord progression, so can you try holding back on that a bit more...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
...
Okay, let me give it another try.
Several dozen minutes later

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Sorry, it's just...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I'm doing my best not to make it sound so cheerful, like you said...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But I guess I'm just not getting it...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Sorry, I'm trying to understand what you want this song to be about, but I'm sort of not sure what I'm doing wrong anymore...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: It doesn't sound all that pop to me...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Ichi...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: It's just, I believe this is the best way to get your message across, you know...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
I get what you mean...
And this melody's a great expression of who you are, Ichi.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But I still want it to really be about empathy and understanding, you know...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: The way it is now, it feels like someone's pushing me towards the finish line... And that doesn't really go with my chord progression.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (I don't understand...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (No matter how many times we try, we can't seem to get on the same page...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (I thought Ichi and I would immediately be able to figure out what each of us was thinking...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Empathy...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: That's what you want this song to be about, Saki?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah, it is.
So if you can make your melody reflect that!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: If that's true, then I need to say something.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: The first verse and chorus use too many minors, which makes the song feel really dark and gloomy.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: There's no warmth. There's no source for your empathy...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
B-But...!
If you make it too warm, then it's gonna be really superficial!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Superficial...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
*Nod*
I know it's easier to express feelings of fun and joy by using happy and cheerful sounds.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But I don't think you can really show empathy by doing just that.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Take us for example. We went through some rough stuff before understanding how we all felt. Only then were we able to feel that warmth. I mean, remember how happy we all were?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah, I do...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (Am I not explaining things right...?)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (I mean, Ichi knows that pain. She's suffered like we all did.)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (So why...?)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Alright, for example... What if we went with this kind of sound instead?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: It's not a big change from what you have now, but just a little darker...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I'm sorry, Saki.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But given the overarching theme, this just isn't going to work.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wait, are you saying...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: A melody I came up with isn't going to work?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: No, that's not what I'm saying...!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: It's just... Even if we do go with your idea, I don't think it's going to turn out well.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
...
Then I guess we should just scrap everything and start over from scratch.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Sorry, I didn't mean to say that...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: It's just... Nothing's really felt right to me either, you know?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I tried and tried to make mine sound the way you want, Ichi...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But it never feels like it's getting better.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: This is a lot harder than I realized it would be...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Sorry, I'm going to go buy something to drink.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Okay...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (Why is nothing going right...?)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (I was so sure that Ichi and I would be able to write an amazing song together...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But if this keeps up, we might not even be able to finish it, let alone reach the next level...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (What do we do...?)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (Should we go apologize to Mr. Shindo and the others, and ask if I can write a song like I always do...?)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (But I don't know if I can write a next-level Leo/need song all on my own...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (Also...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I don't want things to end this way...
<Saki!>

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Huh...?
